description: Ranked search over one data model's records, by the model's id or slug. Exact identifiers rank first, then full-text and semantic matches (semantic only when the model has it on) ranked together. Each hit carries the record id, the matching snippet and its matchKind (EXACT, LEXICAL or SEMANTIC); mode says whether the search ran HYBRID or LEXICAL only, and indexing means some records are still being indexed. Use get_record for a hit's full data; use list_records to filter by exact field values.

locale.description: Match only this language plus non-localized text, e.g. 'pl'. All languages when omitted.

modelIdOrSlug.description: The model's id or slug (from list_models)

query.description: What to look for: words, a phrase, or an exact identifier such as a SKU

name: search_records
title: Search records
